plain_statement: It is false that: The edge function of the Petersen graph minus a vertex (9 inputs, 12 edges); a circuit of AND, OR (two-input) and NOT gates for it whose first gate computes OR(x_4, x_6). If it has at most 15 gates, then each of the inputs x_4 and x_6 is read by exactly one gate after the first.
